name: weighted seated tuck crunch on floor
description: A seated tuck that brings the knees and chest together while holding a weight, targeting the lower abs.
instructions: Sit on the floor holding a weight at your chest, leaning back slightly with legs extended.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Pull your knees in while bringing your chest forward.
Extend your legs again without touching the floor.
Keep your back long and breathe steadily.
